A journey of reason

The Path

Honest answers to the biggest questions a person can ask. Each page sets out the evidence and then the strongest objections to it, so you can weigh them yourself. Start with whichever question matters most to you.

Is there a Creator?

  • Can we know that anything is real? Before asking where the universe came from, it is fair to ask whether we can trust that it exists at all.
  • Did the universe have a beginning? What modern cosmology says about whether the universe has always existed.
  • Does the universe need a cause? If the universe began, what could explain its beginning? Quantum physics, infinite chains and simulations, examined one by one.
  • One Creator or many? Why the unity of natural law points to a single source.
  • If God exists, why is there suffering? The hardest question many people ask, taken seriously.

Revelation and the Prophet ﷺ

  • Would the Creator communicate with us? If there is a Creator, would it leave us without guidance? And how would we recognise guidance if it came?
  • Who was Muhammad ﷺ? How to evaluate someone who claims to be a messenger, and what history records about Muhammad ﷺ.

The Quran

  • Is the Quran preserved? How the Quran has been transmitted, and how that can be checked.
  • Does the Quran contain knowledge ahead of its time? The descriptions of nature in the Quran, and the most common objections to them.
  • The Quran's literary challenge The Quran challenged its audience to produce a single chapter like it. What exactly is that challenge?

Meaning

  • What is the purpose of life? Islam's answer, and what follows if life has no given purpose.

Prefer to be guided one question at a time?
